look.summary_zh: 黑白 · 中灰近原值 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 130.5/255（变化 +3.0 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.294。中灰红减蓝 +0.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EBEBEB、#AEAEAE、#4A4A4A；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #616161、#979797、#7B7B7B。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 130.5/255 (+3.0 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.294; mid-gray red minus blue +0.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EBEBEB, #AEAEAE, #4A4A4A. Red/green/blue swatches: #616161, #979797, #7B7B7B.
look.suggested_use_zh: 黑白纪实、建筑与轮廓试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 强度低于 1 会混回原始彩色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
